quarterly_data.quarter: Japan Electronic Materials semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 12,322 million (+25.2%), operating income JPY 2,657 million (+29.6%), ordinary income JPY 2,448 million (+22.7%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,698 million (+26.0%). Management attributes the sales growth to a large expansion of memory probe card sales and the profit growth to higher utilization and production efficiency at its domestic plants; it describes demand for leading-edge semiconductors such as GPUs for generative AI and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) as the driver of the semiconductor market, while the recovery in smartphone and automotive chips lagged.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 12,322 million (+25.2%); operating income JPY 2,657 million (+29.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Japan Electronic Materials semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor test parts segment, first half (semi-annual report): demand for non-memory probe cards stayed weak, while memory probe cards grew strongly as the company raised output for leading-edge semiconductors in Japan and overseas, where its sales are expanding, and for its main customers, whose demand was recovering gradually. Segment net sales JPY 12,212 million (+25.5%), segment profit JPY 3,573 million (+36.1%), with the cost of up-front investment in future capacity and product strength offset by higher domestic plant utilization and efficiency, product mix, and hiring that slipped into the second half. Electron tube parts: net sales JPY 109 million (+0.5%). First-half R&D expenses JPY 824 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Segment net sales JPY 12,212 million (+25.5%); segment profit JPY 3,573 million (+36.1%)
